newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Stray bullet wounds Brazilian baby boy.
newsitem.headline: Stray bullet wounds Brazilian baby boy.

text.p: A nine-month-old baby boy was wounded by a stray bullet while he was sleeping in his father's arms during a circus performance, a police spokesman said on Monday.
The parents of Lucas Cabral Albano had taken the baby boy to see a Sunday performance of the Moscow Circus in Rio de Janeiro when the stray bullet wounded his right arm, the spokesman said.
He was taken to a hospital immediately and remains under observation.

A similar incident claimed a life in July, when a 42-year-old man, who was also attending a circus performance in Rio, was killed by a stray bullet which entered the circus tent from one of the nearby shantytowns.
Almost every week Brazilian newspapers tell the story of yet another stray bullet victim.
